notes.label: Job
notes.quote: Put money aside steadily for a future life event or planned purchase without turning saving into another chore.

notes.label: Trust
notes.quote: Automation only works if customers always understand why money moved, when it moved, and how to stop it.

notes.label: Rules
notes.quote: Explain clearly how round-ups work, including transaction timing, refund handling, and when transfers happen.

notes.label: Scope
notes.quote: Shared ownership introduces permissions, social UX, and disclosures that do not help prove the core habit loop.
